sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Uribe re-elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Álvaro Uribe wins May's vote in the first round on his hardline security record.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Parapolitics' scandal erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: Revelations of politicians' ties to paramilitaries trigger arrests of congressmen.

sport.headline: Colombia misses the World Cup
sport.summary: A sixth-place finish in qualifying keeps Colombia out of Germany 2006.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hostage diplomacy dominates agenda
geopolitical_news.summary: Chávez mediates with the FARC over captives including Íngrid Betancourt; talks collapse in November.

geopolitical_news.headline: Paramilitary demobilization probed
geopolitical_news.summary: Justice and Peace tribunals expose atrocities as demobilized fighters confess.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Colombia fails to advance in Venezuela, losing to Paraguay and the United States.

geopolitical_news.headline: Operation Jaque frees Betancourt
geopolitical_news.summary: A daring July military ruse rescues 15 hostages, including the Franco-Colombian politician.

geopolitical_news.headline: Reyes raid sparks regional crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: Colombia kills FARC leader Raúl Reyes in Ecuador in March, rupturing ties with Quito and Caracas.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying struggles
sport.summary: Colombia sits mid-table in the CONMEBOL race for South Africa 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: US bases deal angers neighbors
geopolitical_news.summary: A military cooperation pact with Washington draws fury from Venezuela and Ecuador.

geopolitical_news.headline: Uribe re-election bid blocked
geopolitical_news.summary: The constitutional court rules out a third term in February 2010, ending his hopes.

sport.headline: Colombia misses South Africa 2010
sport.summary: A seventh-place qualifying finish extends the World Cup absence to 12 years.

geopolitical_news.headline: Santos elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Juan Manuel Santos wins June's runoff as Uribe's anointed successor.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ties with Ecuador restored
geopolitical_news.summary: Santos and Correa mend relations ruptured by the 2008 Reyes raid.

sport.headline: Falcao shines in Europe
sport.summary: The striker leads Porto to Europa League glory with a record 17 goals.

geopolitical_news.headline: Santos breaks with Uribe
geopolitical_news.summary: The new president distances himself from his mentor over human rights and peace policy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Victims' Law approved
geopolitical_news.summary: Landmark legislation offers reparations to millions of conflict victims.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Colombia loses to Peru in extra time in Argentina.

geopolitical_news.headline: FARC peace talks announced
geopolitical_news.summary: Santos reveals secret negotiations; formal talks open in Oslo and Havana in October.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sea border ruling favors Nicaragua
geopolitical_news.summary: The ICJ awards disputed Caribbean waters to Nicaragua in November.

sport.headline: Pékerman era begins
sport.summary: José Pékerman takes charge and transforms Colombia with Falcao leading the line.

geopolitical_news.headline: Agrarian strike paralyzes countryside
geopolitical_news.summary: Weeks of farmer protests in August force concessions from the government.

geopolitical_news.headline: Peace talks advance in Havana
geopolitical_news.summary: Partial accords on land and political participation are announced.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification sealed
sport.summary: Colombia books Brazil 2014, ending a 16-year absence from the finals.

geopolitical_news.headline: Santos re-elected on peace platform
geopolitical_news.summary: He beats Óscar Zuluaga in June's runoff, framing the vote as peace versus war.

geopolitical_news.headline: FARC declares unilateral ceasefire
geopolitical_news.summary: The rebels announce an indefinite truce in December as talks near completion.

sport.headline: Best World Cup run ever
sport.summary: Colombia reaches the quarter-finals; James Rodríguez wins the Golden Boot.

geopolitical_news.headline: De-escalation in the conflict
geopolitical_news.summary: Both sides agree measures to wind down fighting as a final accord nears.

geopolitical_news.headline: Border crisis with Venezuela
geopolitical_news.summary: Maduro closes the border and deports thousands of Colombians in August.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Colombia loses to Argentina on penalties in the quarter-finals of the Chile-hosted tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Peace accord signed
geopolitical_news.summary: Santos and Timochenko sign the final deal in Cartagena in September.

geopolitical_news.headline: Referendum narrowly rejects accord
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters say No by a whisker in October; Santos wins the Nobel Peace Prize days later.

geopolitical_news.headline: Revised accord ratified
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress approves a tweaked deal in November after the referendum defeat.

sport.headline: Copa América third place
sport.summary: Colombia beats the United States to finish third in the Centenario edition.

geopolitical_news.headline: FARC completes disarmament
geopolitical_news.summary: The UN verifies the handover of thousands of weapons in June.

geopolitical_news.headline: ELN talks open
geopolitical_news.summary: Negotiations with the last major guerrilla group begin in Quito.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification secured
sport.summary: A final-day draw away in Peru secures fourth place and books Colombia's Russia 2018 ticket.

geopolitical_news.headline: Duque elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Iván Duque wins June's runoff, vowing to revise the peace accord.

geopolitical_news.headline: FARC party's poor electoral debut
geopolitical_news.summary: The ex-rebels' new party wins few votes in March legislative elections.

sport.headline: World Cup last-16 exit
sport.summary: Colombia loses to England on penalties in Moscow after a late Mina equalizer.

geopolitical_news.headline: National strike grips Colombia
geopolitical_news.summary: Mass protests erupt in November over economic reforms and police violence.

geopolitical_news.headline: ELN car bombing in Bogotá
geopolitical_news.summary: A January attack on a police academy kills over 20 cadets, ending peace talks.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Colombia loses to Chile on penalties after a perfect group stage.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pandemic lockdowns imposed
geopolitical_news.summary: A months-long quarantine hammers the economy and informal workers.

geopolitical_news.headline: Social leader killings continue
geopolitical_news.summary: Dozens of activists are murdered despite the peace accord's protections.

sport.headline: Football halted by pandemic
sport.summary: Qualifiers and leagues stop; Colombia sacks Queiroz after heavy defeats resume play.

geopolitical_news.headline: Tax-reform protests explode
geopolitical_news.summary: A proposed tax hike in April triggers weeks of deadly unrest, centered in Cali.

geopolitical_news.headline: Reform withdrawn, minister resigns
geopolitical_news.summary: The government retreats in May after dozens die in clashes.

sport.headline: Copa América third place
sport.summary: Colombia beats Peru to finish third; Díaz emerges as a star.

geopolitical_news.headline: Petro elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Gustavo Petro wins June's runoff, Colombia's first leftist president.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Total peace' policy launched
geopolitical_news.summary: The new government opens talks with armed groups across the country.

sport.headline: Colombia misses Qatar World Cup
sport.summary: A sixth-place qualifying finish ends the streak of recent tournaments.

geopolitical_news.headline: Reforms stall in Congress
geopolitical_news.summary: Petro's health and labor reforms face stiff legislative resistance.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ceasefires with armed groups
geopolitical_news.summary: Fragile truces with the ELN and dissidents are announced and repeatedly tested.

sport.headline: Strong start to 2026 qualifying
sport.summary: Under Lorenzo, Colombia goes unbeaten through the year's qualifiers.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cali hosts COP16 biodiversity summit
geopolitical_news.summary: The October UN biodiversity conference in Cali spotlights Colombia's global environmental leadership.

geopolitical_news.headline: Peace talks falter
geopolitical_news.summary: Negotiations with the ELN and dissidents stall amid continued violence.

sport.headline: Copa América final defeat
sport.summary: Colombia loses to Argentina in extra time in Miami after a record unbeaten run.

geopolitical_news.headline: Catatumbo offensive displaces thousands
geopolitical_news.summary: ELN attacks in January force a state of emergency on the Venezuelan border.

geopolitical_news.headline: US relations strained
geopolitical_news.summary: Deportation flights and tariff threats test ties with Washington.

sport.headline: World Cup 2026 qualification secured
sport.summary: Colombia books its ticket with games to spare, returning to the finals.
